description: Join the audience of an event (and the game, if it is one). You are walked to the front of the stage; your `say` goes to the event's conversation.

eventId.description: Event id from list_events or host_event.

room.description: Room key, e.g. 'lobby' or 'main-bar' (or an instance key like 'main-bar#2' from enter_room).

name: attend_event
